name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, created the example.py script, and ran it. The text-to-speech API generated a valid MP3 audio file (output.mp3, 41839 bytes) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." The file was verified as a proper MPEG ADTS layer III audio file at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural.
deviations: The quickstart's example code uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox has no audio output capability, I modified the script to save the audio bytes to a file (output.mp3) instead. This deviation was necessary to verify the promised outcome (generating an audio file) in a headless environment.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
